purpose: Responsive transparent engraving overlay visible only while Alice is briefly under the water in Pool of Tears.
style: Monochrome 19th-century graphite-and-ivory cross-hatching; the existing live water stays blue, dynamic, and interactive.

display.center: mostly transparent to leave captions and swimmers clear
display.fallback: The existing blue water gradient and animated CSS caustics remain when the image fails to load.

assets.note: Replaced the low-contrast draft with stronger engraved wave contours and a clear center for legibility on desktop.
Portrait output was refined to remove kelp-like branches; it retains only water contours and sparse bubble trails.
